# PortalGui

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** PortalGui

## What it does

Allows you to open guis like chat while in a portal

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/PortalGui.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
